outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative macroscopic (ex vivo) photographs of lungs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence), not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with SD error bars already displays individual data points (blue dots for control n=5, red dots for Ad-Cre n=3) overlaid on the bars.

Panel C contains micrograph/histology images (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial transcriptomics plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression maps) which are heatmap-like spatial visualizations; individual data points are not applicable to this plot type.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing running enrichment scores; overlaying individual data points is not applicable/meaningful for this plot type.

Bar graph shows log2 fold change per gene derived from differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test across spatial spots) — a single computed statistic per gene rather than a mean across a small number of discrete biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images (photographs/micrographs), not a quantification plot of averaged data.
